title: taz2024full: Analysing German Newspapers for Gender Bias and Discrimination across Decades

bias_targets.methodology: Actor-level linguistic discourse analysis using Named Entity Recognition (NER) and pronoun coreference resolution to determine the binary gender of actors (men vs. women). The pipeline then evaluates bias by measuring actor counts, mention frequencies, sentiment towards specific genders, frequency of gender-coded words, and the Pairwise Mutual Information (PMI) of adjectives associated with each gender.
